##### Project general facts

La Dimora by Reportage Properties is an exclusive residential chalet community with 75 beautifully designed homes, combining Mediterranean-inspired architecture with modern comfort. The project offers spacious four-bedroom townhouses, creating an attractive choice for families looking for privacy and generous living space.

Residents can enjoy an excellent range of amenities, including a large swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and fitness center, landscaped areas, a kids’ play area, shaded seating spaces, and private parking for every chalet. A convenient retail zone and easy access to the beach add even more comfort to the relaxed lifestyle offered by the community.

The chalets feature contemporary finishes combined with elegant Mediterranean-inspired design, creating bright and welcoming interiors with a strong connection to outdoor spaces. The brochure presents stylish living areas, modern kitchens, warm natural tones, and wood-inspired details, giving the homes a refined yet comfortable atmosphere, while the furniture and decorative accessories shown are for illustration purposes only.

##### Location description and benefits

Durres region is a beautiful coastal destination in Albania, known for its sandy beaches, warm Mediterranean atmosphere, and scenic Adriatic Sea views. Its relaxed seaside character creates an appealing environment for residents seeking comfort, sunshine, and a pleasant everyday lifestyle.

The region combines coastal living with convenient access to vibrant towns, local restaurants, cafés, shops, and cultural attractions. Residents can enjoy a balanced lifestyle with opportunities for beach recreation, outdoor activities, and leisurely walks along the waterfront.

Durres region also benefits from its strategic position, offering convenient connections to Tirana and Tirana International Airport as well as other parts of Albania. With its attractive coastline, growing infrastructure, and welcoming atmosphere, the region provides an enjoyable setting for both permanent living and relaxing stays.
